decision: Retain bundled semantic v2. CutMix reduces extras but loses stone/ship recall and does not recover the validation portal. Both raw checkpoints are retained as research evidence.

comparison.change: Aligned training-only CutMix at probability .5, with a separate RNG and excluded cut boundaries.
comparison.unchanged: Initial weights, v4 dataset and splits, original crop streams, seed, optimizer, learning rate, loss, schedule, architecture, selection, threshold and inference.
comparison.baseline_reports: Bundled-v2 and trial-22 fixed reports are reused. No inference or decoding source changed.

adaptation: Pixel, point-heatmap and review-mask patches move together. The original CutMix paper uses image-level labels; this dense-target adaptation is our experiment.

recipe.method: frozen segmentation with physical light centers

data.annotation_changes: None. The two previously observed diagnostics are evaluated separately from the training manifest.

timing_note: Training wall time includes validation/checkpoint writing and overlapped part of the CPU test suite. It is not a controlled speed comparison; runtime inference is unchanged.
selection: Maximum validation F0.5 at fixed .35; earliest tie. The last model is a separately identified diagnostic, not a replacement selected using tests.

portal_pixel_comparison.scope: Local pixel equality diagnostic on fixed training/validation labels only; no model selection or label changes.

portal_context_diagnostic.purpose: Swap increasingly wide centered patches between train and validation portals. Only diagnostic inputs change; neither labels nor checkpoints are fitted.
portal_context_diagnostic.limits: Two already-observed images with near-identical local portal artwork. Other sources may be inserted or removed, so no whole-image accuracy is claimed.

limits: Agent-reviewed labels, not independent human ground truth.
All test maps were already observed in earlier trials; no fresh unseen-style claim.
Ship and Astral reviews are partial; whole-image precision remains unknown.
Artwork families overlap across public-map splits, although layouts stay separate.
One cool validation portal and repeated use of five validation maps limit checkpoint-selection evidence.
The patch-swap probe establishes sensitivity for two particular images, not a general mechanism or accuracy estimate.
The 32-pixel cut margin does not guarantee that very large emitters remain intact.
No live Foundry import, other GPU/OS, or release packaging was run for this training-only change.
